senses.definition: Provided that, if, assuming (depending upon some condition or requirement).
senses.example: I don't mind if he stays there, as long as he cleans up after himself when he's done.

senses.definition: For the entire duration that; while; since.
senses.example: As long as you're here, you may as well help me with the garden.

senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see as, long.
senses.example: It took three times as long as I expected (= three times longer than I did).

senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see as, long.
senses.example: These meetings can last as long as three hours.
